messages:
ryan_sales: Heads up — AcmeCorp legal asked for an attestation letter + pen-test letter + SOC 2 cert for the Dedicated POC. They also want staging creds so their security team can run the test harness. Timeline is EOD Thu. Any blockers?

marta: :wave: We can provide the SOC 2 cert PDF and a signed attestation letter. Pen-test letter — we usually provide a pen-test attestation from our last engagement rather than standing up a new test. What level of detail do they need in the pen-test letter (full report vs attestation)? :lock:

devon: For staging creds we can either spin a time-limited staging account in their VPC or issue an API key scoped to a restricted project. Recommend ephemeral creds + IAM role binding. If this is Dedicated they may expect reserved capacity pricing — @samira for pricing.

samira: I can draft pricing. Quick Q: Dedicated (reserved GPUs) or Private (customer-managed infra)? Dedicated adds monthly commit. For short POCs we typically offer a 14-day eval: `20% off` + credits. I can also provide a sample config and runbook.

ryan_sales: They want Dedicated for the demo. Also legal expects a signed pen-test letter from us or from our third-party. They said "recent pen-test within 12 months."

marta: We have a NexSec engagement from last year (report + signed attestation). I'll pull the redacted attestation and prepare a pen-test cover letter. Link (redacted): https://redwood-sec.s3.amazonaws.com/attestations/nexsec-2025-attestation.pdf — legal will need to review redactions.

security-bot: Reminder: before sharing full vulnerability reports or raw findings, run the DLP sharing workflow (`sc-share`) and get Legal + Security approval. See sharing guide: https://internal.redwood/security/sharing-guidelines

devon: For staging creds here's the example command we'll use internally to create an ephemeral key:```bash
rsc create-key --ttl 72h --scope poc-acmecorp
```We can hand over rotated creds via secure vault; will need an infra ticket to provision network/peering.

samira: I'll prepare a checklist for what we'll hand over and a pricing quote. Ryan — can you confirm they signed the NDA? We require NDA before sharing full pen-test PDF.

ryan_sales: They signed the standard mutual NDA earlier this week (attached to the SFDC opp). SFDC link: https://sfdc.example.com/0QxABC123 — I'll confirm legal is happy. Also, procurement asked whether we support customer-managed KMS in Dedicated — that's a potential blocker.

marta: KMS in Dedicated isn't GA. We can document network isolation, audit logs, and offer additional controls, but customer-managed KMS / HSM is supported in Private only. If KMS is a hard requirement we'll need to escalate to Product for a Private deployment evaluation.

devon: Opening infra ticket for staging creds + VPC peering: INFR-4829. ETA ~48 hours. Will update ticket with required CIDRs and rotation plan. Ping me if we need to accelerate.

samira: Pricing note for planning: example Dedicated footprint for demo — 2x A100: ~$9k/mo (provisionally), 4x A100: ~$18k/mo. For a short 3mo eval we can offer a provisional quote with a 14-day free trial + one-time onboarding fee (~$2k). I'll send a formal quote by EOD.

ryan_sales: Timeline recap: need SOC2 cert, attestation letter, redacted pen-test attestation, and staging creds by Thu EOD. Blocker: KMS requirement from procurement — may force Private deployment.

marta: I'll draft the attestation + pen-test cover letter and route to Legal for language by tomorrow morning. :+1:

samira: Sending provisional quote and checklist by EOD. I'll include lower-cost options (reduced GPUs or quantized models) in case they push back.

ryan_sales: Thanks team — I'll follow up with AcmeCorp legal and confirm NDA acceptance. If anything urgent comes up, DM me. :thumbsup:
